welcome.title: Welcome to Agenda Docente!
welcome.body: We'll show you the essentials in 6 quick steps to get your school year organised. It'll take less than a minute.

schedule.title: School year and timetable
schedule.body: First things first: set your stage, region and terms in School year (the app will ask you for this as soon as you sign in). Then build your weekly class timetable in Timetable. Everything else is organised from there.

subjects.title: Subjects and Students
subjects.body: Add your subjects and link them to your region's official curriculum. In Students, add your pupils by group: you can take tutoring notes and create checklists.

planning.title: Weekly and annual planning
planning.body: Plan each class session day by day in Weekly planning (mark absences, outings and holidays), and get the big picture of the year by Learning Situation in Annual planning.

grades.title: Grades and Comments
grades.body: Create rubrics, record grades and calculate the final mark in Grades. Then generate personalised report comments for each student in Comments.

organize.title: Tasks and Meetings
organize.body: Jot down what's pending in Tasks and organise meetings with families or your team in Meetings, with your own folders and colours.

profi.title: Activate Profi, your AI assistant
profi.body:
Profi helps you generate rubrics, exams, comments and much more across the app. To activate it:
1. Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/app/apikey with your Google account.
2. Paste it into Settings → Artificial intelligence.
And Profi will be ready to help!

profi.subtitle: AI teaching assistant
profi.welcome:
Hi! I'm **Profi**, your teaching assistant 👋

I can help you with class ideas, phrases for your students, lesson unit planning, assessment activities, and any question about your teaching practice.

I'm an AI system (Gemini): I can make mistakes, so always review what I suggest before using it.

Where shall we start?
